{{Quote|The seismic activity team has identified over a hundred thousand sites that need investigation down there, and it's not always easy to tell whether we're looking for a magma well, a terrorist attack, or a building collapse.|Wynn Dorvan, reporting to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
The '''seismic activity team''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] organization tasked with locating [[Groundquake/Legends|seismically]] dangerous sites across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[44 ABY]], the world was [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|assaulted]] by a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] and the [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]], a [[Destructors|destroyer]] of civilizations. Although Abeloth was [[Duel at the Font of Power|eliminated]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces were [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|defeated]], Coruscant sustained heavy damage. The seismic activity team was thus dispatched to identify positions that required careful examination, and they reported over 100,000.

==History==
{{Quote|The volcanic activity has stopped everywhere on the planet&mdash;though it will probably be years before we have even a basic survey of the damage to the undercity.|Wynn Dorvan, after the planet-wide disaster in 44 ABY|<ref name="Apoc" />}}
[[File:Abeloth.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Abeloth]]
The seismic activity team was established on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[44 ABY]], operating under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the planet came under the control of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]]&mdash;who periodically rose over the [[Time/Legends|millennia]] to [[Destructors|destroy]] civilizations&mdash;and the recently [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|resurged]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. The [[New Jedi Order]] and Galactic Alliance [[Duel at the Font of Power|defeated]] Abeloth and [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|eradicated]] the Sith, but Abeloth caused massive [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity all across the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] while the last surviving Sith were hunted through the [[City/Legends|city]], leaving destruction in their wake.<ref name="Apoc" />

The seismic activity team was quickly tasked with gauging the damage done to the world. Though the volcanic activity had ceased, they found that the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] had been so ravaged by the attack that it would likely require years to acquire just a rudimentary assessment. The team also had trouble identifying what to look for, as possible causes of the widespread destruction included [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] assaults, fountains of [[Magma/Legends|magma]], and structural failure. The undercity was further swamped with clouds of [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gas, and preliminary estimates of the civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]] were in the billions. The seismic activity team ultimately reported well over 100,000 sites that were in need of further inquiry. Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] later relayed the team's findings to the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Apoc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The seismic activity team was mentioned in author [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2012]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the ninth and final volume of the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Apoc" />
